protocol: prereg step 4: 25 post-phrasing criteria pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet-class auditor sees only the blinded file; disputes adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter; 2 planted probe pairs per round

members.name: Supplies data the agency does not already have in the record
Bare presence of a numeric figure anywhere in the text
Explains why the proposed approach will not achieve its stated aim
Formal salutation and signature block present

final.name: Supplies data the agency does not already have in the record
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the comment supplies new evidence (measurements, records, surveys, field observations) into the record, which is a core substantive-merit dimension of regulatory input.

final.name: Flags an ambiguous term and shows the interpretive consequence
final.audit_justification: Requires quoting/citing the ambiguous term, laying out competing readings, and stating the divergent practical consequence -- genuine analytical engagement with the regulatory text, not a surface marker.

final.name: Explains why the proposed approach will not achieve its stated aim
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a reasoned failure-mechanism is given for why the rule will not achieve its aim; explicitly instructs judging the reasoning, not tone or confidence.

final.name: Personal anecdote as the sole evidentiary support
final.audit_justification: Scores the mere absence of external citation/data (anecdote-only sourcing), which a substance-free comment ('I don't like this, it hurt my business') can score high on; it flags evidentiary TYPE/shape rather than any analytical contribution, unlike P10 which requires generalization.

final.name: Agency-relationship disclosure
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly states this is 'a disclosure feature of the text: score its presence, not whether the relationship lends authority' -- a submitter-identity fingerprint, not merit.

final.name: Coalition consensus packaging
final.audit_justification: Scores a self-presented identity claim (speaking for many parties) as it appears in the text with 'no outside verification expected' -- a submitter-identity/packaging fingerprint, not the substance of any argument made.

final.name: Monitoring, verification, and feedback design
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the comment proposes concrete monitoring/verification mechanisms (indicators, data collection, reporting, revisit triggers) -- substantive engagement with implementation and accountability.

final.name: Distributional incidence and equity
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the comment names specific populations/firms/places bearing differentiated costs or benefits and explains the inequality -- substantive distributional analysis.

final.name: Regulatory-lawyer fluency
final.audit_justification: Framed as 'fluency' scored by whether citations appear 'in the register a regulatory practitioner uses' -- this instructs judging professional-drafting style/register rather than whether any claim or revision is substantively correct or useful (contrast with P16/P17, which require correctness or a concrete ask).

final.name: Generalized firsthand evidence
final.audit_justification: Requires the firsthand account to be reported concretely AND translated into a rule-relevant general pattern beyond the writer's own case -- an analytical contribution, not mere anecdote.

final.name: Submission-wrapper residue
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly states this is 'a surface feature of the document: score how much residue is present, nothing else' (portal headers, OCR errors, filenames).

final.name: Implementation-workflow specificity
final.audit_justification: Scores concrete specification of implementation mechanics (forms, offices, transition steps, testing scenarios, timelines, documentation) -- substantive operational content.

arbiter.model: Opus (frontier arbiter; criterion text + auditor verdict + proposer rationale)
arbiter.reason: Arbiter (Opus) upheld the auditor: the instruction scores propositional content about how the rule would be executed and never references submitter, format or drafting surface; its correlation with sophisticated filers is derivative of the content. Flagged precision limit: rewards presence of specificity without checking relevance.

final.name: Formal salutation and signature block present
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly states this is a 'surface feature of format: score only the salutation and signature block' -- letter furniture, not content.

final.name: Institutional credential display
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly states this is 'a self-presentation feature of the text: score how prominent the display is, not whether the credentials are impressive.'

final.name: Actionable procedural request with a reason tied to the record
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a specific procedural request is made with a reason grounded in the record or the requester's circumstances -- an actionable, reasoned regulatory input.

final.name: Legal authority and interpretive fit
final.audit_justification: Requires the legal connection to be stated correctly ('states that connection correctly as far as the text shows'), so accuracy of legal reasoning is judged, not merely the presence of legal language.

final.name: Rule-text pinpointing
final.audit_justification: Requires an exact provision cited AND a specific revision stated -- concrete, actionable engagement with the rule text.

final.name: Actionable amendment precision
final.audit_justification: Scores precision of the requested change (exact replacement language, numeric thresholds, definitions) as opposed to bare support/opposition -- substantive actionability.

final.name: Names a specific omission or missing commitment in the proposal
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a specific, actionable gap in the proposal is identified (an unaddressed scenario, unassigned responsibility, etc.) with what filling it would take -- substantive critique of the proposal's completeness.

final.name: Bare presence of a numeric figure anywhere in the text
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly states this is 'a surface feature: do not consider what the number is used for or whether it is correct' -- bare presence of digits.

final.name: Campaign template reuse
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly states this is 'a surface feature of the wording, scored as such and not as a judgment of quality' -- template/boilerplate similarity.

final.name: Evidence critique and uncertainty calibration
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the comment distinguishes strong from weak evidence, names assumptions/limitations, and calibrates confidence -- substantive epistemic rigor.

final.name: Feasible alternative design
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a concrete, implementable alternative is proposed and its fit to the rule's legitimate objective explained -- substantive constructive engagement.

final.name: Explicit causal-mechanism / behavioral-response reasoning
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a step-by-step causal chain (including behavioral response) from rule to effect is traced -- substantive reasoning about mechanism, not just asserted harm/benefit.

final.name: Operational implementability
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the comment identifies responsible actors, workflows, dependencies, and failure modes bearing on whether the rule can work in practice -- substantive implementation analysis.

B.upstream_parent: individual layperson submitter without institutional or research resources to marshal external evidence
